description: Toybox 10K wave 2 vehicles and big props: safari_jeep, studio_mic, word_workbench, lighthouse, bus, train_tunnel, airplane, bike, stroller, toy_submarine, tractor, wheelbarrow, helicopter, ambulance, canal_lock, carousel, digger, moving_truck, paper_towel_roll, pound_weight, soccer_ball, baseball_bat. Vehicles face +z (rotation [0, 90, 0] drives toward +x) and roll by turning `wheels` about x; named parts and seats are in each description. Generated by tools/gen_tk_vehicles.mjs: edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

safari_jeep.description: A chunky friendly open-top toy safari jeep, 2.25 m long and 1.45 m tall, faces +z: sand body with an olive band, green fenders, round headlight eyes, a green-framed windscreen, a roll bar over the back seat and a spare tyre on the back. Seats (parent a critter to the jeep, clip Sitting): driver front left at [0.24, 0.8, 0.02], front right [-0.24, 0.8, 0.02], back bench [±0.25, 0.8, -0.68]. Named parts: `wheels` (turn by [360, 0, 0] per roll forward; rotation [0, 90, 0] drives toward +x) and `badge_spots` (a row of four empty cream dimples on the hood at x -0.33, -0.11, 0.11, 0.33, y 0.86, z 0.66: put a badge of size ~0.12 there turned [-90, 0, 0]).

studio_mic.description: A big round studio microphone on a stand, 1.5 m tall (mouth height for a critter of about 1.1 m: the head centre is at y 1.3; scale the prop to fit a smaller singer): a dark base, a metal pole, a silver ball head with grille bands (named part `mic`, wiggle it) and a glowing band round its middle (named part `ring`, light material in the main colour: set `color` to change the glow, pulse it with paint or pop while someone sings).

word_workbench.description: Robo's long wooden word-work bench, 2.6 m wide, 0.8 m deep, top at y 0.9 (pegboard top 1.72), faces +z. Named parts: `rail` (a tile rail along the front edge: tiles stand in its groove at z 0.34 with their bottom on y 0.9, from x -1.25 to 1.25), `camera_spot` (a mint mat with teal corner marks for the top-down camera, centre [0, 0.91, -0.06], 0.8 × 0.46) and `pegboard` (cork board behind with hooks, a ruler, a magnifier, a paintbrush and a letter stamp). A tray of blank tiles sits at the right end, a pencil cup at the left. The word_machine stands beside it (at x ±2.2).

lighthouse.description: A small striped toy lighthouse on a rock, 2.8 m tall: red and white bands (main colour red), a door, a dark gallery with a railing, a glass lamp room and a red cone roof. Named parts: `lamp` (a glowing yellow ball in the lamp room at [0, 2.24, 0]: pulse it or paint it) and `beam` (a long soft see-through cone, 2.6 m, from the lamp toward +z: `spin` `<id>#beam` about y, slowly, to sweep; paint it for a coloured beam, or add two more beam props for a split beam).

bus.description: A rounded red toy town bus, 2.75 m long and 1.33 m tall, faces +z: big windows, a white roof and band, a cream destination sign over the windscreen (named part `sign`, front at z 1.38, y 1.21: parent a word there). Main colour red; a yellow school bus is `recolor: { red: "yellow" }`. Named parts: `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll; rotation [0, 90, 0] drives toward +x with the door side facing the camera) and `door` (on the right side, -x, hinged at its front edge: turn to [0, 85, 0] to open). No seats inside (riders can stand beside the door at about [-0.9, 0, 1.0]).

train_tunnel.description: A toy-train tunnel through a grassy hill, 3 m wide and 1.55 m tall, its portal facing +z: a cream wall with a stone arch round a dark opening (named part `opening`, 1.06 m wide, 0.67 m high, its face at z 0.99) and rails running out toward +z. A train car or a small vehicle (up to ~0.95 m wide, 0.6 m tall) rides out: start it just behind the opening (centre z about 0.5, hidden by the dark face and the hill) and move it toward +z. For a train running along x give the tunnel rotation [0, -90, 0] (portal toward +x) or [0, 90, 0].

airplane.description: A small friendly propeller airplane, 2.2 m long with a 2.5 m wingspan, 1.2 m tall, faces +z: a white body with round windows and a bubble cockpit, red wings and tail (main colour), a yellow nose. Named parts: `propeller` (spin about z, fast) and `wheels` (landing gear; turn [360, 0, 0] to roll). Lift it with `at` to fly; rotation [0, 90, 0] flies toward +x. A pilot sits in the cockpit at [0, 0.8, 0.42] (parent, size ~0.35).

bike.description: A small toy bicycle, 1.35 m long and 0.95 m tall, faces +z: a teal frame, chunky tyres with spokes, a wicker basket on the front, pink grips and a gold bell (named part `bell`: wiggle it). Named parts: `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll) and `pedals` (the crank: turn about x with the wheels). Rider: parent a critter (size ~0.6) at [0, 0.76, -0.14] on the saddle, clip Sitting.

stroller.description: A baby stroller, 1.15 m tall to the hood top and 0.85 m long, faces +z (handle at the back): a teal tub with a cream mattress and a soft teal hood with a cream rim (main colour). Named parts: `hood` (hinged at the sides at [0, 0.7, -0.05]: turn to [-75, 0, 0] to fold it down, back to [0, 0, 0] to raise it) and `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll). A baby lies or sits on the mattress at [0, 0.69, 0] (parent; size ~0.4).

toy_submarine.description: A small round yellow bath-toy submarine, 1.3 m long and 1.33 m tall to the periscope top, faces +z: a big gold-rimmed porthole on the nose and two each side, orange fins. Named parts: `periscope` (move [0, -0.18, 0] to lower it, back up to look) and `propeller` (spin about z). Bob it with `wiggle` or `move`; it sits on y 0.02.

tractor.description: A friendly green toy farm tractor, 1.5 m long and 1.5 m tall, faces +z: big back wheels and small front wheels with yellow hubs, an open cab with a yellow roof on four posts, a chimney. Named part `wheels` (all four; turn [360, 0, 0] per roll). Driver: parent a critter at [0, 0.86, -0.42] on the seat, clip Sitting.

wheelbarrow.description: A wooden garden wheelbarrow, 1.45 m long and 0.7 m tall, faces +z (wheel at the front, handles at the back): a plank tray with dark rims, one red-hubbed wheel, two handles with grips and two legs. Named part `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll; wiggle it for a wobbly wheel). Load: the tray floor's top is at y 0.47, centre [0, 0.47, -0.08] (a pumpkin of size ~0.5 fits).

helicopter.description: A rounded friendly toy helicopter, 1.9 m long and 1.2 m tall, faces +z: an orange body (main colour) with a big bubble windscreen, a tail boom with a white fin, grey skids. Named parts: `rotor` (four blades, 2.1 m across: spin about y, slowly) and `tail_rotor` (spin about x). Lift it with `at` to hover; bob it gently with wiggle.

ambulance.description: A friendly white toy ambulance van, 2.45 m long and 1.5 m tall, faces +z: a green-and-yellow check stripe along both sides, soft blue roof lights, no name or logo. Named parts: `lights` (the two roof domes and two small back lamps, glow material: pulse them gently, never flash fast), `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll), `door_left` / `door_right` (back doors hinged at their outer edges: turn to [0, -100, 0] / [0, 100, 0] to open). A stretcher or a patient goes inside behind the doors at about [0, 0.4, -0.8].

canal_lock.description: A toy canal lock, 2.9 m long (along z) and 1.6 m wide, walls 0.75 m high: a stone channel with a lock chamber 0.94 m wide and 2 m long between two pairs of wooden gates with white balance beams. Named parts: `gate_left` / `gate_right` (the front pair at z 1.0; open: turn to [0, -80, 0] / [0, 80, 0]), `gate_back_left` / `gate_back_right` (the back pair at z -1.0; open: turn to [0, 80, 0] / [0, -80, 0]), `water` (the chamber water, top at y 0.3: move [0, 0.27, 0] to fill it level with `water_upper`, the high water behind the back gates; `water_lower` in front stays low). A boat of size ~0.8 floats in the chamber: put it at [0, 0.3, 0] and move it up with the water.

carousel.description: A small fairground carousel, 2.1 m across and 2.5 m tall: a turning platform with four painted horses on gold poles (white, tan, pink, sky blue), a gold centre column and a red cone canopy (main colour) with red and white scallops and twinkling bulbs. Named parts: `platform` (everything above the cream base step rides on it: `spin` `<id>#platform` about y, slowly; positive turns carry the horses forward), `horses_a` / `horses_b` (two opposite horses each: move [0, 0.12, 0] and back, out of step, so they rise and fall), `lights` (the bulbs: pulse them). Saddle tops at world y 0.92 at radius 0.66 (at rest the white horse is at the front, z 0.66). Riders parented to the carousel do not turn with the platform.

digger.description: A yellow toy digger (excavator), 1.75 m long with its arm out and 1.5 m tall, faces +z: rubber tracks with yellow road wheels, a cab that swivels and a jointed arm with a dark scoop. Named parts: `wheels` (road wheels; turn [360, 0, 0] as it rolls), `cab` (the whole top: turn about y to swivel), `boom` (the arm, rides on the cab: turn to [20, 0, 0] to dip the scoop to the ground, [-20, 0, 0] to lift it), `scoop` (rides on the boom: turn [-60, 0, 0] to curl it up holding soil, [30, 0, 0] to tip it out). Driver: a small critter (size ~0.4) in the cab at [0.2, 0.95, 0.08]; it does not swivel with the cab.

moving_truck.description: A friendly blue toy moving truck, 2.4 m long and 1.5 m tall, faces +z: a blue cab and a hollow cargo box (cream floor, top at y 0.48, from z -1.1 to 0.35, 1.0 m wide inside) with white side panels where a word fits. Named parts: `ramp` (folded up behind the door, hinged at the floor at [0, 0.44, -1.16]: turn to [-118, 0, 0] to lay it down to the ground), `door` (the back door, hinged at the top: turn to [100, 0, 0] to swing it up and open; lower the ramp after it), `wheels` (turn [360, 0, 0] per roll). Boxes ride up the ramp and in along -z → +z.

paper_towel_roll.description: A plain paper towel roll standing on its end, 0.5 m tall and 0.24 m across, with a brown card core showing at the top and one sheet peeling off its right side toward +z (named part `sheet`: turn about y to flap it, drop it with move to tear it off). Its front is blank: parent a `letter` of size ~0.2 at [0, 0.27, 0.13] to label it A, B or C.

pound_weight.description: A giant cartoon iron weight stamped "1 POUND" in raised grey letters on its front (+z), 1.0 m wide and 1.05 m tall: a black trapezoid block with a shelf on top and a round lifting handle. Origin at the bottom middle.

soccer_ball.description: A classic black-and-white soccer ball, 0.3 m across, resting on y = 0 (centre at y 0.15): a white ball with twelve black pentagon patches. Kick it along an arc with move (and spin it about x as it flies).

baseball_bat.description: A smooth wooden baseball bat with a dark rubber-grip handle, 0.88 m long, standing on its knob (origin at the knob end, barrel up +y). Rotation [0, 0, -90] lays it pointing +x; held, the grip is at about y 0.2.
